scope: all tracked Markdown/MDX/RST/AsciiDoc/README references; named diagram sources and fenced diagram blocks; all tracked image/PDF candidates require classification
limits: Inventory is not accuracy, coverage, rendering or product acceptance.
Purpose labels are triage candidates, not proof of historical/current authority.
Nested/indented fences, inline HTML, ASCII art, diagrams inside binary documents and uncategorized assets require manual review.
Blob prefixes are navigational identifiers, not integrity certificates.

Historical evidence must retain its actual source and bytes; do not rewrite it to describe current behavior. Reference triage does not reopen accepted runtime outcomes or require stable inference replay.
